1.title: Former Florida Rep. David Rivera Sentenced to 10 Years in Venezuela Lobbying Case
1.summary: David Rivera, a Miami Republican, was convicted of secretly lobbying officials in Washington on behalf of the Venezuelan government in 2017 and 2018.

2.title: Christa Pike Was Unconscious and on Ventilator After Execution Attempt
2.summary: The Tennessee inmate was brought to a hospital with burned and blistered arms after an unsuccessful attempt at lethal injection, her lawyers said in a court filing.

3.title: Judge Throws Out Another Confession in Sept. 11 Case
3.summary: Prosecutors have long considered the defendants’ admissions during interrogations in 2007 to be their best evidence.

4.title: Widdecombe Murder Suspect Charged With Preparing Acts of Terrorism, Including Against Farage
4.summary: Joshua Kerry, a 28-year-old British man accused of killing the former lawmaker Ann Widdecombe, was charged on Friday.

5.title: Mass Shootings Surge in South Africa as Illegal Guns Flood Streets
5.summary: The country was shaken after nearly 30 people were killed in two separate mass shootings. South Africans are demanding greater government intervention.

6.title: Fighting Intensifies in Yemen, Raising Fresh Fears of All-Out War
6.summary: Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, was bombarded overnight, after government forces reported some of the most intense clashes in years around Taiz, the country’s third largest city.
